description.zh: 任务管理与职场记忆：维护 TASKS.md 任务清单，记住你的同事、项目和术语，并能生成可视化看板。可连接聊天 / 邮件 / 项目跟踪类连接器自动同步。
description.en: Task management and workplace memory: keeps a TASKS.md list, remembers your people, projects, and terminology, and renders a visual board. Syncs with chat / email / tracker connectors when connected.

welcome_message.zh: 任务、人脉、项目进展，说出来我帮你记着
welcome_message.en: Tasks, people, projects — just say it and I'll keep track

zh: 初始化我的任务清单和工作记忆，先问我几个问题了解我的角色和优先级
记下这些任务：周五前评审预算提案、和 Greg 同步后起草 Q2 路线图、跟进平台组的 API 规范
做一次全面梳理：清理过期任务、检查记忆缺口、把外部工具里的新待办同步进来
en: Initialize my task list and workplace memory — ask me a few questions about my role and priorities first
Add these tasks: review the budget proposal by Friday, draft the Q2 roadmap after syncing with Greg, follow up on the API spec from Platform
Do a full sweep: triage stale tasks, fill memory gaps, and pull new todos in from my connected tools

description.zh: 建立任务清单，并了解角色和优先级
description.en: Set up the task list, role, and priorities

prompt.zh: 初始化我的任务清单和工作记忆，先问我几个问题了解我的角色和优先级
prompt.en: Initialize my tasks and memory — ask about my role and priorities first

description.zh: 用一句话一次记下多条任务
description.en: Several tasks in one natural sentence

prompt.zh: 记下这些任务：周五前评审预算提案、同步后起草 Q2 路线图、跟进 API 规范
prompt.en: Add these tasks: budget review by Friday, Q2 roadmap after syncing, follow up on the API spec

description.zh: 清理过期任务、补全记忆缺口
description.en: Triage stale tasks and fill memory gaps

prompt.zh: 做一次全面梳理：清理过期任务、检查记忆缺口
prompt.en: Do a full sweep: triage stale tasks and fill memory gaps

description.zh: 记下同事、项目和内部说法

prompt.zh: 请把这些人和项目记进工作记忆。之后我用简称时直接对应，不要再问是谁：
prompt.en: Save these people and projects in workplace memory. Next time I use a shorthand, map it without asking who they are:

description.zh: 按状态把当前待办整理成看板
description.en: Group current tasks into a board

prompt.zh: 请根据当前任务清单做一块看板：按状态分组，标出过期项和今天该做的事。
prompt.en: Build a board from the current task list: group by status, and mark what's overdue and what's due today.

description.zh: 从聊天或邮件里收进新待办
description.en: Pull new todos out of chat or email

prompt.zh: 请从我贴出的聊天或邮件里抽出新待办，补进任务清单，并标出还缺负责人或截止日期的条目：
prompt.en: Pull new todos from the chat or email below, add them to the task list, and flag items missing an owner or due date:
